description:
Send a working specialist a follow-up instruction.

Use it when the work changed after you started the specialist, such as a corrected size, address or account. Name the specialist by its ID. A specialist another one called, such as the login a checkout called, takes follow-ups too, and its caller reads them in its result. Write only what changed, in your own words. When the account to sign in with changed, also put it in `account_hint`, which replaces the specialist's sign-in account. The specialist reads the message after its current step, so a step already underway still finishes. A message refines the instruction. It cannot change the specialist's kind or its tab. To change those, stop the specialist and start a new one. Never include a password. A one-time code Muse sent you for a login agent's site goes to that login agent.

id.description: The specialist's ID, such as s3.
